core_question: How do I clean my dog's ears at home?
answer_summary: Squeeze a vet ear-cleaning solution into the canal, massage the base to loosen debris, let the dog shake its head, then wipe out loosened wax with a cotton ball, avoiding swabs deep in the canal.
